search_notes.name: Search Notes
search_notes.summary: Search through your Obsidian notes by keyword. Returns matching file names and metadata.

list_directory.name: List Directory
list_directory.summary: List the vault's folder structure: an overview with file counts at the root, files and subfolders inside a folder. Output is collapsed to fit the context budget.

read_content.name: Read Content
read_content.summary: Read notes and vault files by path or wiki link. Supports markdown/text files and PDF text extraction. Images must be attached in chat.

grep_notes.name: Grep Notes
grep_notes.summary: Find an exact substring or regex pattern across notes, returning matching lines with line numbers and context. Unlike Search Notes, it matches literal strings. Scope to one note with a path, or page large result sets.

get_all_tags.name: Get All Tags
get_all_tags.summary: Retrieve a list of all tags used in the vault.

get_properties.name: Get Properties
get_properties.summary: Retrieve frontmatter properties from notes or list all property keys in the vault.

execute_javascript.name: Execute JavaScript
execute_javascript.summary: Run isolated JavaScript for calculations and data transformation. Use return for the final value and console.log for intermediate output.

manage_notes.name: Manage Notes
manage_notes.summary: Create, update, or delete markdown notes in one staged batch. Related note operations can be proposed together for user approval.

fetch_url.name: Fetch URL
fetch_url.summary: Fetch a public web page or text resource over HTTP(S) and return its main content as cleaned markdown. Use only with URLs the user provided or clearly public references.

web_search.name: Web Search
web_search.summary: Search the web and return results (title, URL, snippet). Configure the provider and API key in the tool's Configure panel. Prefer vault search first.

manage_skills.name: Manage Skills
manage_skills.summary: Create new skills, revise the agent's own attached skills, or delete a skill when you ask it to. Changes apply immediately. A skill's name and plugin link are locked once created.

write_todos.name: Task List
write_todos.summary: Lets the agent plan multi-step work as a checklist and tick it off as it goes. The list shows above the chat input.

ask_question.name: Ask Question
ask_question.summary: Lets the agent pause and ask you a multiple-choice question when a request is unclear. The question shows above the chat input.

web_search.firecrawl_key_help: Optional — add a Firecrawl API key (fc-…) for higher rate limits. Leave empty to use the keyless tier.
web_search.brave_key_help: Brave Search API key from api.search.brave.com.
web_search.keenable_key_help: Optional — add a Keenable API key for higher rate limits. Leave empty to use the free public endpoint.
